crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…
I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls…
men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens…
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither…
Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…

translations.web: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
translations.bsb: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
translations.kjv: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
translations.asv: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
